suggestions: I'm grateful for the CI pipeline going green on the first try after I touched the build config.
I'm thankful for my mum still packing extra sambal even though I moved out years ago.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm thankful for the quiet ten minutes before Subuh when the whole house is still asleep.
I'm grateful for a teh tarik that's actually hot when it reaches the table, not lukewarm from sitting at the counter.
I'm thankful for finding the root cause of a bug in the logs instead of three hours of guessing.
I'm grateful for the aircon in the office finally getting fixed after everyone complained in the group chat.
I'm thankful for a manager who just says "take the day, we'll manage" without making it a whole thing.
I'm grateful for rain starting right after I got home instead of while I was still on the bike.
I'm thankful for a deploy on a Friday that didn't blow up and ruin the weekend.
I'm grateful for nasi lemak from the stall that still remembers I don't take cucumber.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's voice note reminding me to eat properly, even when I didn't ask.
I'm grateful for a Stack Overflow answer from eight years ago that still solved my exact problem today.
I'm thankful for the salary coming in on time this month, no delays, no excuses needed.
I'm grateful for a long drive back to my hometown with nothing but good traffic and an even better playlist.
